title: Standard Course Docker Run Pattern
description: A 7-line docker run command with flags that enforce boundaries: --rm for self-cleaning, -it for interactive terminal, --add-host for host.docker.internal, two volume mounts for identity and workspace, -w to set working directory, and the image with tool name.

steps.description: The command mounts the agent's home directory for persistent auth, the shared workspace for read/write, sets the working directory to /workspace, and runs the commercial-ai image with claude.
Line 2 makes host.docker.internal resolve to the host machine IP so the container can reach the local gateway.
Lines 3-4 mount two directories: the first persists the agent's authentication tokens and settings; the second is the workspace the agent reads and writes.
Line 5 sets the container's working directory to /workspace so the agent's world is exactly the workspace mount.

steps.question: What does the first volume mount persist?
steps.answer: the agent's authentication tokens and settings
